en.hubeali:
Muhammad Bin Yahya, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad, from Ibn Fazzal, from Abu Jameela, from Jabir, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Ja’far<sup>asws</sup> having said:
‘There were white turbans upon the Angels Sent on the Day of Badr’.
en.sarwar: 3. Muhammad ibn Yahya has narrated from Ahmad ibn Muhammad from ibn Faddal from abu Jamilah from Jabir who has said the following: “Abu Ja‘far, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, has said that
the angels had turbans hanging on them on the day of Badr.”
